description: The exact current date and time in any IANA time zone, with UTC offset, weekday, abbreviation and Unix timestamp, daylight saving time handled. Optionally convert a given moment into up to 10 other time zones in the same call. Use when an agent needs to know what time it is, to schedule a meeting across time zones, or to turn a timestamp into local time. Costs $0.001 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

at.description: Optional moment to convert, as ISO 8601 with an offset (default: now)

to.description: Optional comma-separated time zones to convert the same moment into (max 10)

zone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. Europe/Stockholm or America/New_York

name: time
